purpose: Test whether smaller PPO steps improve fine-tuning from the same behavior-cloned policy. The default-rate control remains unchanged and must finish.

evaluation.initial_means: Same full policy tensors as the learned behavior-cloning parent, with zero additional PPO updates.

changed_training_setting: Constant optimizer learning rate: 3e-4 in the existing control, 3e-5 in the new arm.
fixed_checkpoint_selection: Own initial, first checkpoint at or above 50k, and full-budget final. No performance-based checkpoint selection.
resource_policy: One simulator worker; at most three concurrent simulator workers across this arm, the original imitation PPO pilot, and gSDE recovery.
failure_behavior: Stop and preserve all outputs; no automatic retries.
limitations: One training seed; reused development scenarios; an exploratory rate comparison selected after observing partial training diagnostics.
A shared 62,744-transition demonstration dataset and one supervised fitting seed are reused across both PPO arms.
Both full actor and untrained critic tensors start identically; only PPO optimization rate changes.
Equal live-transition budgets do not imply equal optimizer steps because KL stopping depends on the learned policy.
Route guidance and static-area filtering remain on; aircraft-conflict filtering is off.
Training source differs in rate configuration, validation and reporting; evaluation uses exactly the same frozen implementation.
No official or reserved unseen scenario results may be used for selection.
